Investigator Valeria is a Hollyphant who can be found in the Open Hand Temple.
“
Another case closed, another bottle open! Huzzah to Valeri-AH!
„
— Valeria

Overview

Act Three

Main article: Solve the Open Hand Temple Murders

Valeria can be found investigating various murders happening in Baldur's Gate. Initially found talking to  Sister Yannis, she can be found afterwards in Sharess' Caress at X: 24 Y: 93, getting drunk.

Later on Valeria is kidnapped by members of the Cult of  Bhaal. The party can find her at the Murder Tribunal, and either rescue or sacrifice her to Bhaal. If saved, Valeria is recruited for ⁠Gather Your Allies.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Joyous Trumpet ()

Blow air from your trunk, causing no damage at all but making a trumpet sound. Toot!

 Trumpet of Blasting ()
Damage: 2~8
2d4⁠Thunder
Blast a cone of celestial noise from your trunk that knocks creatures  Prone.
 CON Save
 Recharge: Per turn
 Trumpet of Sparkles ()
Damage: 4~32
4d8⁠Radiant
Blast forth a cone of celestial sparkles. Evil creatures have  Disadvantage on the  Saving Throw, and Good creatures take no damage.[See Notes]
 CON Save
